summary: Hannah prays: my heart exults in Yahweh, horn exalted, no one holy like Yahweh, no rock like God, talk no more proudly, bows of mighty broken weak girded strength, barren bears seven, Yahweh kills and makes alive brings down to Sheol brings up, makes poor rich, raises poor from dust, seats with princes, pillars of earth are Yahweh's. Then Elkanah goes to Ramah, boy Samuel ministers before Eli. Sons of Eli worthless knew not Yahweh, despise offering with fork, lie with women at entrance, Eli rebukes, sons don't listen for Yahweh would kill them. Boy Samuel grows in favor with Yahweh and men. Man of God comes to Eli says I revealed to house of father in Egypt, chose tribe Levi, gave offerings, why kick at sacrifice? Honor those who honor me, those despise shall be lightly esteemed, I will cut off strength, no old man in house, sign both sons die same day, will raise faithful priest.
whyItMatters: Hannah's song mirrors Mary's Magnificat (Luk 1) — reversals: hungry filled, barren bears, bows broken. Sets theme: God raises poor, topples mighty. Also contrast Samuel vs sons of Eli.

keyVerses.text: There is no one as holy as Yahweh, for there is no one besides you, nor is there any rock like our God.

He raises up the poor out of the dust. He lifts up the needy from the dunghill to make them sit with princes and inherit the throne of glory. For the pillars of the earth are Yahweh’s. He has set the world on them.
keyVerses.why: Reversal — poor raised, Mary echoes in Magnificat.

keyVerses.text: “Therefore Yahweh, the God of Israel, says, ‘I said indeed that your house and the house of your father should walk before me forever.’ But now Yahweh says, ‘Far be it from me; for those who honor me I will honor, and those who despise me will be cursed.
keyVerses.why: Principle — honor to those who honor Yahweh.

themes: sons of Eli worthless vs Samuel grows

questions.question: What does Hannah's prayer mean with bows broken, hungry filled, barren seven?
questions.answer: Song of reversals: bows of mighty broken, weak girded strength, full hire themselves for bread hungry cease hungering, barren bears seven (complete), has many children languishes. Yahweh kills makes alive, brings down to Sheol brings up, makes poor rich. Those who were high brought low, low lifted. Mary in Luke 1 Magnificat borrows heavily — God scatters proud, puts down mighty, exalts lowly, fills hungry, rich sent empty. Hannah's personal reversal (barren to mother) becomes lens for God's way of working — raising lowly.

questions.question: Who are sons of Eli and why worthless?
questions.answer: Sons Hophni Phinehas priests in Shiloh, worthless (sons of Belial, no Yoke), knew not Yahweh, treated offering with contempt: when any man offered sacrifice, servant comes with three-prong fork while flesh boiling, takes whatever fork brings up — taking best before fat burned to God (against law). Also lie with women who served at entrance. Eli old rebukes but sons don't listen for it was Yahweh's will to kill them (divine hardening). Contrast boy Samuel ministering wearing linen ephod, growing in favor with Yahweh and men — like Jesus in Luke 2:52.

questions.question: What does man of God prophecy to Eli mean about cutting off strength and raising faithful priest?
questions.answer: Man of God reminds Eli: I revealed to house of father Aaron in Egypt, chose tribe Levi for altar, ephod, offerings, gave Israel's offerings, why kick at sacrifice and offering which I commanded? Honor sons above me? Eli honored sons who Despised offering, taking best. Principle: those who honor me I will honor, despise lightly esteemed. Judgment: cut off strength (arm), no old man in house, both sons die same day as sign, will raise faithful priest who shall do according to heart and mind, build sure house, walk before anointed forever. Points to Samuel and ultimately Zadok and messianic priest.

glossary.def: Horn = strength, like animal horn — lifted high, power.
Sons of Belial — worthless, no yoke, lawless.
Priestly garment, linen ephod for boy Samuel ministering.
